result: I would change the world by ensuring that every person has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water. This is a fundamental human right that is still not guaranteed for many people around the world. According to the United Nations, around 2.2 billion people lack access to safely managed drinking water, leading to numerous health issues and even deaths, particularly among children. By providing universal access to clean water, we could significantly improve global health, reduce poverty, and promote overall well-being. This would also have a positive impact on the environment, as people would no longer need to rely on polluted or unsustainable water sources.
